defect: The location filter also lets diagnostics without a location through, so diagnostics about members of types from referenced assemblies are reported again instead of being dropped.
why: Members loaded from metadata have no source location, so their diagnostics carry Location.None. Dropping exactly those is the point of the filter; the added Location.None branch defeats it.
